description: Return display data for one to fifty product IDs from the Creative Market website API: title, canonical product URL, full description, preview image URLs, shop name and URL, starting price and category. The price is the lowest of Creative Market's four license tiers; the response includes a licensing note with a link to full pricing.

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.

product_ids.description: List of product IDs to look up (up to 50)

name: get_product_details
title: Get product details
